default_recipient.description: Recipient of LP+dust for `ZapBalance`. Also the fallback for `Zap`. `ZapBalance` errors until this is set.

input.description: Royalty input asset for `ZapBalance`. Optional — leave unset for a lazy deploy and wire it later via `UpdateConfig` once the stream is ready. `ZapBalance` errors with `RoyaltyRouteUnset` while unset.

min_zap_amount.description: Minimum input-side balance the keeper path will act on. Below this, `ZapBalance` errors so keepers stop wasting gas.

owner.description: Owner with admin rights (UpdateConfig, Sweep, AddKeeper/RemoveKeeper). Defaults to the instantiator.

pair.description: Royalty target pair for `ZapBalance`. Same lazy semantics as `input`.

tip_bps.description: Caller tip on `ZapBalance`, in basis points of the input-side balance. 0 disables the tip. Capped at 100 bps (1%) in code.

AssetInfo.description: AssetInfo contract_addr is usually passed from the cw20 hook so we can trust the contract_addr is properly validated.
